guard_correction.description: The whole-section ownership check now runs whenever --require-whole-section is present, independently of whether retail comparison arguments are present.
guard_correction.command:
python3 -m py_compile tools/externalize_elf_symbol.py configure.py
mkdir -p build/GEDE01/remediation-2-tests
cp build/GEDE01/src/game/game_fn_8000755C.o build/GEDE01/remediation-2-tests/three-arg.o
cp build/GEDE01/src/game/game_fn_8000755C.o build/GEDE01/remediation-2-tests/five-arg.o
set +e
python3 tools/externalize_elf_symbol.py build/GEDE01/remediation-2-tests/three-arg.o @60 --require-whole-section 2>&1
three_status=$?
python3 tools/externalize_elf_symbol.py build/GEDE01/remediation-2-tests/five-arg.o @60 lbl_8023B0B0 orig/GEDE01/sys/main.dol --require-whole-section 2>&1
five_status=$?
printf 'three_arg_exit_status=%s\nfive_arg_exit_status=%s\n' "$three_status" "$five_status"
test "$three_status" -ne 0 && test "$five_status" -ne 0

per_function_measurement.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
for name in ('800119FC', '801A6C58', '801A6CB4'):
    path = f'reports/GEDE01/objdiff-game_fn_{name}-session-1518-remediation-2.json'
    data = json.load(open(path))
    sides = []
    for side in ('left', 'right'):
        symbol = next(s for s in data[side]['symbols'] if s['name'] == f'fn_{name}')
        relocations = []
        for offset, row in enumerate(symbol['instructions']):
            ins = row['instruction']
            reloc = ins.get('relocation')
            if reloc:
                relocations.append((offset * 4, ins['formatted'], reloc.get('type_name'), reloc.get('addend', '0')))
        sides.append((symbol, relocations))
    target, base = sides
    differences = sum(row.get('diff_kind') not in (None, 'DIFF_NONE') for row in target[0]['instructions'])
    print(f'fn_{name} target_size={target[0]["size"]} base_size={base[0]["size"]} match_percent={target[0]["match_percent"]} instruction_differences={differences} relocations_equal={target[1] == base[1]}')
PY
